transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss Line 4's rinse water situation before Monday. As we all know, Line 4 currently uses fresh rinse water during each production shift, and a municipal water-conservation restriction begins Monday that will limit nonessential fresh-water use at the plant. The good news is that a closed-loop rinse-recovery skid has already been installed beside Line 4 but hasn't been placed into production service yet. I'd like to hear from each of you on the technical findings so I can make an informed authorization and operating-control decision. Let's go through the pre-run huddle process and get your formal findings on the record.
